generic_colonial_exploration_events.1.d.en: Such greatness cannot be contained by mere individuals!

generic_colonial_exploration_events.1.de.en: The great age of charting the horizons has brought forth a generation of skilled navigators and adventurers eager to uncover the unknown. Among them, many renowned explorers such as [target_character_1.GetName] and [target_character_2.GetName] have risen to prominence, each hungry to set forth and make a name for themselves.\n\nTheir competitive nature has spurred both to greater heights, striving to outdo one another in skill and ambition. As their rivalry intensifies, one of them has begun to stand out, their exceptional talent shining brighter than ever before, ready to lead our people to even greater glory.

generic_colonial_exploration_events.2.de.en: After months of perilous journeys and meticulous charting, our explorers have returned with detailed accounts of distant lands and uncharted waters. Their findings are extraordinary, offering both immediate opportunities for further expeditions and insights that could advance navigational science.\n\nHowever, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] is divided on how best to use this wealth of knowledge. Some argue for empowering the most promising explorer to continue pushing the boundaries, while others advocate for channeling these discoveries into technological progress to benefit future generations. The decision will surely shape the course of our people's exploration endeavors.

generic_colonial_exploration_events.3.b.en: Let us not disturb the status quo.

generic_colonial_exploration_events.3.de.en: Settlers in [target_charter.GetName] have proposed a plan to convert the local natives to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetReligion.GetName] and subsequently to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetName] culture, believing that such efforts would not only bring spiritual enlightenment but also foster closer integration with the colony.\n\nBy embracing our ways, the natives could contribute more directly to the colony's growth and prosperity. However, such an endeavor would require significant financial support from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName] to fund missionary work and cultural programs. While some see this as a vital investment in the charter's future, others warn against interfering with the natives' way of life, fearing it could disrupt the fragile balance in the province.

generic_colonial_exploration_events.4.a.en: We can only hope this trend carries on.

generic_colonial_exploration_events.4.de.en: Word of the ample lands and promising opportunities in [target_charter.GetName] has begun to spread throughout the homeland. Merchants, farmers, and adventurous families alike are captivated by tales of prosperity and freedom in this new world.\n\nEncouraged by the successes of early settlers, many are now preparing to make the journey across the seas in search of a better life. This surge of interest promises to bolster the colony's population and accelerate its development, transforming it into a thriving hub of activity and growth.

generic_colonize_explore_BUTTON_DETAILS.en: The vast world beyond our borders is full of mysteries and opportunities. By exploring uncharted regions and establishing colonies, we can secure our place in history and shape the destiny of our realm!

generic_colonize_explore_BUTTON_TOOLTIP.en: The unknown offers limitless potential for growth, wealth, and prestige. We must embrace it.

generic_colonize_explore_CRITERIA_DESCRI.en: We have either begun exploring uncharted waters or established the foundations for colonial expansion.

generic_colonize_explore_DESCRIPTION.en: The call of distant horizons and unclaimed lands stirs our ambitions. We must chart the seas, discover new territories, and expand our influence to ensure our realm's future prosperity.

mission_chart_horizon_desc.en: Expeditions of adventurers at land and at sea will harness the horizon, exploring and crafting maps of lands never before seen by our people.

mission_colonial_ambitions_desc.en: Settling foreign shores and utilizing their resources is a great way to further our mercantile reach and, consequently, our power as well. To that end, we must seek to establish colonial subjects, ready to serve and promote our interests.

mission_colonial_ambitions_tt.en: One of our colonial [subjects|e] will receive a #G reduction#! to their [liberty_desire|e]
mission_colonial_ambitions_tt.uk: One of our colonial [Concept('subjects','васали')|e] will receive a #G reduction#! to their [liberty_desire|e]

mission_hire_explorer_desc.en: We need able-bodied explorers to properly harness the unknown.

mission_new_maps_desc.en: In order to properly grasp the gravity of new discoveries, we must push for expeditions to charter and complete the mapping of those territories.

mission_overseas_efforts_desc.en: It has become apparent that we stand at the precipice of a new age. To march forth and claim unknown lands is to carve our name into the annals of history for centuries to come.

mission_settle_horizon_desc.en: The need for expansion has led our advisors to support the notion of sending people to potential colonies. The influx of settlers will undoubtedly lead to the dissemination of knowledge and the adoption of new technologies as well as raw goods.

mission_settle_horizon_tt.en: Monthly [events|e] about our colonial settlements may occur while this [mission_task|e] is active
